run_playwright_cli: run the playwright CLI entry point that delegates to the compiled driver executable with sys.argv arguments
build_driver_command: build the driver executable path and CLI argument list by calling compute_driver_executable
test_driver_env: test that get_driver_env returns the correct environment variables for the playwright driver subprocess
review_main_entry: review the main entry point function that wraps the driver executable in a subprocess call with KeyboardInterrupt handling
summarize_driver_delegation: summarize how the __main__ module delegates all CLI invocations to the compiled playwright driver binary
